newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly softer, high sulphur up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly softer, high sulphur up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly softer, apart from high sulphur which surged on tight supply.
Gasoline was weaker with the oil complex. U.S. arbitrage trade was not considered workable.
Naphtha was softer with crude. Petrochemical demand was seen poor, while demand for n+a barrels was better.
Gas oil was fundamentally firm but outright prices ended lower as IPE gas oil futures shed recent gains.
High sulphur barges surged by up to $4. The mini boom was attributed to tight supplies even though bunker demand was poor.
